name: [CHURCH] Anomaly Watch
desc:
Anomaly Watch is a horror game inspired by the Mandela Catalogue and the I'm On Observation Duty games. In Anomaly Watch you are sent to explore a rural house where unexplainable events happen, objects go missing, become distorted, and strange humanoids appear. Your job is to recognize and report unexplainable events and most importantly, report unrecognizable creatures and intruders. All in all survive until 6 am. Good Luck!

House Keybinds:
PC: Equip Tablet - R
Mobile: Equip Tablet - Button on side of the screen.

Office Keybinds:
Flashlight: F or Gamepad B
Sprint: Left Shift or Gamepad R1
Exiting the reporter: Jump

Horror outside human comprehension.
Thank you for playing Anomaly Watch

Developer: punitto
Icon art: Jslay0_0

scripts.title: UWU HUB
scripts.features:
# UWU~~~ | ANOMALY WATCH v70

A multi-feature utility script focused on visibility, movement, anomaly tracking, and map interaction.

## Main Features

### 🏆 Auto Win (Works on All Maps)
Automatic win assistance system designed to function across all supported maps.

### 👹 Monster ESP
Detects and highlights dangerous moving entities with red highlight and floating name labels.

### 📍 All Objects ESP
Displays every detectable object around the map with full path/name display.

### 📦 Item ESP
Tracks collectible and interactable items with orange indicators and optional tracers.

### ⚠️ Anomaly ESP
Monitors tracked objects and detects abnormal changes (position, size, color, material, transparency, physics, textures, brightness, parent changes, creation, disappearance, child count).

### ⚡ Speed (25)
Increases movement speed.

### 🕊 Fly (PC Only)
Free flight movement with full directional control.

### 🚪 Noclip
Walk through objects and collisions.

### ☀️ Fullbright
Removes darkness and improves visibility.

### 🔭 FOV (100)
Expanded field of view.

### 👒 Chinese Hat
Cosmetic neon hat visual with glass styling.

### 💗 Pink Trail
Creates a moving trail effect behind the player.

Modern UI with multiple tabs, toggle system, minimize mode, and mobile support.
